buildIdentity.missingIdentityNote: The captured precompact campaign manifest records DLL hashes but not the source commit, source archive digest, or exact runner digest.

inputs.packageCatalogIsolation: source .ppmap catalog was passed directly; private package snapshots were not used

measurement.readyEndpoint: first successful actual present after all eight players are spawned and alive
measurement.percentiles: nearest-rank; P99 is the maximum in each 20-sample cell

counterInterpretation.allocatedBytes: approximate process-wide delta since request from GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(false); a counter estimate, not exact retained or allocated object memory
counterInterpretation.processCpuMilliseconds: process-wide processor-time delta since request; not main-thread time and not wall time
counterInterpretation.workingSetBytes: current process working-set sample at the readiness point
counterInterpretation.peakWorkingSetBytes: process-lifetime high-water mark sampled at readiness; not a request-only peak, retained managed bytes, or VRAM
